top_findings.title: standings() double/triple-counts a season — 2019 Flamengo shows 76 played / 180 pts (truth 38 / 90)
top_findings.evidence: soccer_mcp.py:187 filters competition by substring (competition.lower() not in m.competition.lower()), so competition='Brasileirão' (the tool default, soccer_mcp.py:184) matches BOTH 'Brasileirão' and 'Brasileirão (histórico)'; soccer_mcp.py:105-121 concatenates 5 match files with no dedup. Empirical: d.standings(2019) → Flamengo played=76 pts=180 (W56 D12 L8), Atlético-MG played=114 (triple). Confirms the first evaluator's R9 inflation claim. Captured by the separate factual_accuracy column (0.5), NOT a missing capability.
top_findings.suggestion: Deduplicate matches on (season, date±1d, home, away) before aggregating, or scope standings to a single canonical competition source.
